title: Sinus pressure louder today?
caption: Head pressure building? Today has a small wobble—little ups and dips, then it evens out. Work in short runs with small breaks, try slow breathing and a gentle neck and jaw stretch, and soften screens later.
snapshot: Geomagnetic activity is a bit unsettled. Solar wind looks typical, with the field dipping south at times. No solar flares showed up. One CME was seen and is background context only.
affects: Some may notice head or sinus pressure rising and fading. Focus can come in shorter runs with small dips between. Mood and patience may wobble for a few, even if most people feel fine. Sleep can hold up if the evening stays light and simple.
playbook:
- Take a few minutes of slow breathing
- Gentle neck and jaw stretches; soften screens
- Hydrate and add a pinch of salt if you need it
- Step outside for natural light
- Check local air and allergens, adjust plans
